checks.name: committed_source
checks.detail: No local commit; remote CI has no immutable source commit

checks.name: committed_worktree
checks.detail: Commit the reviewed source and evidence before selecting a release SHA

checks.name: github_target
checks.detail: Set the intended GitHub OWNER/REPO and origin; no repository is inferred from the Go module

checks.name: release_tag
checks.detail: Select existing tag v0.3.0; current build scripts use this fixed version

checks.name: registry_target
checks.detail: Choose the exact lowercase ghcr.io/OWNER/IMAGE destination and package visibility

checks.name: SHA256SUMS
checks.detail: all listed payload hashes match; this does not authenticate a publisher

checks.name: IMAGE-SHA256SUMS
checks.detail: all listed payload hashes match; this does not authenticate a publisher

checks.name: remote_configuration
checks.detail: Repository/default branch, Actions policy, exact-commit run, tag, runner availability and package access cannot be verified without an accessible target

checks.name: registry_write_and_visibility
checks.detail: Read-only preflight does not authenticate to or push a registry; verify package Actions write access and intended visibility before publication

checks.name: formal_publication
checks.detail: Only artifact preparation is automated. An authorized maintainer must select the target, review candidate hashes/security notes and explicitly publish the GHCR manifest and GitHub Release

action_refs.verification: read-only official GitHub API refs; annotated pnpm v4 tag dereferenced to commit

local_validation.acceptance_structure: passed: 45 AC, 10 scenarios, local documentation links and evidence indexes

local_ci_rehearsal.environment: Dedicated Debian 13 arm64 complete VZ VM; native aarch64 CPU; Linux 6.12.111+deb13-cloud-arm64

integration.restic: restic 0.19.1 compiled with go1.26.4 on linux/arm64

tests.name: installation preserves pre-existing container ID and running state
authentication, single setup, CSRF, API404 and daemon capability enforcement
dashboard counts match independent Engine inventory and repeated refresh preserves resources
tests.detail: independent CLI/Engine HTTP; running/stopped/paused fixtures; three refreshes; IDs/config/mounts/network/state unchanged

tests.name: CLI discovery and Engine-verified lifecycle with task idempotency
healthy container rebuild creates new ID and failing replacement restores original ID/data
real streamed Docker image export and asynchronous tar import
tests.detail: 5242880-byte tar exceeds ordinary API body cap

tests.name: real Compose multiconfig/env/profile import preserves IDs, ports and mounts
stop-writer directory backup, full Restic data read and content/mode/ownership restore
SIGKILL during real stopped-writer Restic backup terminates child and recovers writer on restart
tests.detail: 256MiB random source; direct child executable+PPID+starttime verified through /proc; task Failed/INTERRUPTED

tests.name: container snapshot recreates a running service against verified recovered bind data
tests.detail: original ID remains running; new ID/name/bind path and in-container content independently verified

tests.name: named Volume worker backup and verified restore
worker ambient capability reads foreign UID mode0600 and preserves repository ownership
non-root manager restores foreign UID/GID mode0600 through scoped worker
tests.detail: independent read-only Docker stat and content check

tests.name: real Cron Volume file backup commits snapshot and restart preserves unique UTC task instance
tests.detail: file consistency only; no database consistency claim; no clock or database manipulation

tests.name: restart persists users, sessions, policies and completed tasks
fresh database imports encrypted repository and restores without original SQLite or source directory

limitations: systemd/distro and dual-architecture runtime matrix are separate release checks
daemon configuration mutation/restart is a separate isolated release check

local_ci_rehearsal.original_engine_baseline_scope: Original Engine snapshot taken after first Engine28 integration and before Engine29 integration; compared again after Engine29 integration and Engine28 Buildx rehearsal
limitations: Not a GitHub Actions run, not a verification of target repository policy, billing, hosted runner allocation or token scopes
Official Docker static archives and existing pinned Compose/Restic binaries reused locally; setup actions and hosted-runner download steps not executed
Buildx native fixture was built/loaded/run; full production worker image was a previously verified release artifact, not rebuilt from the entire Dockerfile in this rehearsal
Both local rehearsals are arm64; remote CI declares native amd64 and arm64 jobs but has not executed
